claim: A session spawned by the master without a registry label cannot be addressed by name; the first message to it fails.

metric.what: Sends from the master to a newly spawned helper by its tab name.

recordKinds: a report from the master, not a record
countedFrom.machine: one Windows 11 machine; one master, 8 orchestrators, about 50 short-lived workers, one person
versions: agent harness as installed in the period (exact version not recorded)

proposedChange: Assign a registry label at spawn; a send to a name that is not a label fails with the nearest labels listed.
whyItGeneralises: A name that is not registered at spawn cannot be resolved by any addressing scheme; the failure is structural.
limits: One incident, reported by the master; not independently measured.
